notes: Consul registration: registry.go:85 builds consul.AgentServiceRegistration with ID, Name, Port, Address and no Check field; server.go:78 registers once at startup; the consul service name is srv-rate (server.go:27 const name = "srv-rate"). No heartbeat, TTL or health check is configured in these files; the Consul agent's own check behaviour is a library default, not in these files. Liveness is therefore not reported for this service.

Health check: no healthcheck key in the rate block (docker-compose.yml:102-122) or in compose.observability-placement.yml:22-26; no HEALTHCHECK in upstream/deathstarbench/hotelReservation/Dockerfile:1-19. Docker Compose default (no health check), library default, not in these files.
Container name: no container_name key in docker-compose.yml:102-122; Compose derives the container name, library default, not in these files.

Telemetry: traces to jaeger via jaeger-client (tracer.go:28-39, main.go:56); reporter BufferFlushInterval 1 * time.Second (tracing/tracer.go:36, quotedToken "BufferFlushInterval: 1 * time.Second,"); sampler probabilistic with default ratio 0.01 (tracer.go:14, quotedToken "defaultSampleRatio float64 = 0.01"), overridden by env JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO (tracer.go:20). Overlay sets JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO default 1 and JAEGER_DISABLED default false (compose.observability-placement.yml:25-26). Jaeger agent port 6831 is UDP in docker-compose.yml:231 (quotedToken "6831:6831/udp"); the UDP transport of the jaeger-client agent reporter is a library default, not in these files.
Metrics: none in these files; no metrics library import in services/rate/server.go:3-25.
Logs: zerolog ConsoleWriter to stdout (cmd/rate/main.go:22, quotedToken "zerolog.ConsoleWriter{Out: os.Stdout"); no log shipping configured in these files.

Memcached protocol: gomemcache client (services/rate/server.go:13) against memcached-rate:11211 (config.json:17; main.go:43). MongoDB driver (server.go:21) against mongodb-rate:27017 (config.json:16; main.go:38, db.go:126). Callee service names are the compose keys docker-compose.yml:238 (memcached-rate) and :317 (mongodb-rate).
gRPC server: services/rate/server.go:71 registers the Rate gRPC service on the listener; inbound calls from other services are not reported as calls made by this service.
